scenarios.title: Chiller 2 Bearing Overheat & Vibration Surge
scenarios.description: Simulates raceway spalling and mechanical friction in Centrifugal Chiller 2, causing severe vibration, motor amperage surge (+115 kW), and rapid health score collapse.

scenarios.title: Data Center Unauthenticated Physical Intrusion
scenarios.description: Simulates physical motion and human presence in Mission Data Center (Z-F5-01) without any authorized electronic badge swipe registration.

scenarios.title: Rooftop Cooling Tower Water Main Rupture / Micro-Leak
scenarios.description: Simulates hydraulic makeup water valve sticking wide open on Cooling Tower Deck (Z-F5-04), causing continuous 78 GPM water loss.

scenarios.title: Peak Tariff Demand Surcharge Threat
scenarios.description: Simulates concurrent chiller staging and full elevator traffic during the 14:00 peak utility tariff window, threatening a $5,400 demand charge penalty.

scenarios.title: Reset All Systems to Nominal Baseline
scenarios.description: Clears active fault injections, recalibrates sensor baselines, and restores optimal nominal operational conditions.
